about: Golden vectors for tools/persist_layout.py: a legacy register file (words 0..31, only the non-zero ones listed) and the register file the migration writes, with the values it holds; `resume` shows a migration interrupted after k writes (tools/persist_layout.py WRITE_ORDER, word 0 last) and what the next boot makes of it. Generated by `python3 tools/persist_layout.py --golden`; checked against the firmware by sim/test_persist_layout.py.

cases.name: empty card (all zero: volume 0 is a valid legacy volume)
defaults of a fresh legacy card
a TAU DEV 181 card: volume 73, colour 7, meter 6
volume 100, repeat all, ReplayGain album, polarity light, Halcyon 30
every legacy field at its maximum
out-of-range legacy values read as defaults
a legacy tuning is dropped, last played kept
